derived_posthoc.scope: All45 coordinates, all3 paired seeds, all36 validation points, all4 original theta eps; no selection, no threshold change, no candidate or training authorization. These are central-FD errors; validation qualification is not inferred from training-label qualification.
interpretation_limits: Coordinates23:26 are world-frame linear velocity. This table does not measure body_vz.
A coordinate contribution is arithmetic attribution of mean squared error, not a causal attribution to representation interference or training coverage.
Six models reuse144 unique physical intervals; four eps are retained rather than treated as independent samples.
No validation full-model zero endpoint is available; no one-sided model FD or newly qualified physical defect is inferred.
Five transformed quantities are separate physical-unit summaries and are not added to the seven-group score.
